verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Vai, sobe daqui, tu e o povo que fizeste subir da terra do Egito, para a terra a respeito da qual jurei a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó, dizendo: ë tua descendência a darei.
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Go forward from this place, you and the people whom you have taken up out of the land of Egypt, to that land about which I made an oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed will I give it.

verses.en: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.pt: E enviarei um anjo adiante de ti (e lançarei fora os cananeus, e os amorreus, e os heteus, e os perizeus, e os heveus, e os jebuseus),
verses.en_web: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.en_bbe: And I will send an angel before you, driving out the Canaanite and the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite:

verses.en: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
verses.pt: para uma terra que mana leite e mel; porque eu não subirei no meio de ti, porquanto és povo de cerviz dura; para que não te consuma eu no caminho.
verses.en_web: to a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”
verses.en_bbe: Go up to that land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, for fear that I send destruction on you while you are on the way.

verses.en: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
verses.pt: E quando o povo ouviu esta má notícia, pôs-se a prantear, e nenhum deles vestiu os seus atavios.
verses.en_web: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned: and no one put on his jewelry.
verses.en_bbe: Hearing this bad news the people were full of grief, and no one put on his ornaments.

verses.en: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
verses.pt: Pois o Senhor tinha dito a Moisés: Dize aos filhos de Israel: És um povo de dura cerviz; se por um só momento eu subir no meio de ti, te consumirei; portanto agora despe os teus atavios, para que eu saiba o que te hei de fazer.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You are a stiff-necked people: if I come among you, even for a minute, I will send destruction on you; so take off all your ornaments, so that I may see what to do with you.

verses.en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
verses.pt: Então os filhos de Israel se despojaram dos seus atavios, desde o monte Horebe em diante.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
verses.en_bbe: So the children of Israel took off their ornaments at Mount Horeb, and did not put them on again.

verses.en: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
verses.pt: Ora, Moisés costumava tomar a tenda e armá-la fora do arraial, bem longe do arraial; e chamou-lhe a tenda da revelação. E todo aquele que buscava ao Senhor saía à tenda da revelação, que estava fora do arraial.
verses.en_web: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought Yahweh went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.
verses.en_bbe: Now it was Moses' way to put up the Tent of meeting outside the tent-circle, at some distance away; giving it the name of The Tent of meeting. And everyone desiring to make his prayer to the Lord went to the Tent of meeting outside the tent-circle.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
verses.pt: Quando Moisés saía à tenda, levantava-se todo o povo e ficava em pé cada um à porta da sua tenda, e olhava a Moisés pelas costas, até entrar ele na tenda.
verses.en_web: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.
verses.en_bbe: And whenever Moses went out to the Tent of meeting, all the people got up and everyone went to the door of his tent, looking after Moses till he went inside the Tent.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the LORD talked with Moses.
verses.pt: E quando Moisés entrava na tenda, a coluna de nuvem descia e ficava à porta da tenda; e o Senhor falava com Moisés.
verses.en_web: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and spoke with Moses.
verses.en_bbe: And whenever Moses went into the Tent, the pillar of cloud came down, and took its place by the door of the Tent, as long as the Lord was talking with Moses.

verses.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
verses.pt: Assim via todo o povo a coluna de nuvem que estava à porta da tenda, e todo o povo, levantando-se, adorava, cada um à porta da sua tenda.
verses.en_web: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people saw the cloud at the door of the Tent, and they went down on their faces, everyone at the door of his tent.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verses.pt: E falava o Senhor a Moisés face a face, como qualquer fala com o seu amigo. Depois tornava Moisés ao arraial; mas o seu servidor, o mancebo Josué, filho de Num, não se apartava da tenda.
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord had talk with Moses face to face, as a man may have talk with his friend. And when Moses came back to the tents, his servant, the young man Joshua, the son of Nun, did not come away from the Tent.

verses.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
verses.pt: E Moisés disse ao Senhor: Eis que tu me dizes: Faze subir a este povo; porém não me fazes saber a quem hás de enviar comigo. Disseste também: Conheço-te por teu nome, e achaste graça aos meus olhos.
verses.en_web: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people:’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to the Lord, See, you say to me, Be this people's guide on their journey, but you have not made clear to me whom you will send with me. But you have said, I have knowledge of you by name, and you have grace in my eyes.

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
verses.pt: Se eu, pois, tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, rogo-te que agora me mostres os teus caminhos, para que eu te conheça, a fim de que ache graça aos teus olhos; e considera que esta nação é teu povo.
verses.en_web: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me now your way, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight: and consider that this nation is your people.”
verses.en_bbe: If then I have grace in your eyes, let me see your ways, so that I may have knowledge of you and be certain of your grace; and my prayer is that you will keep in mind that this nation is your people.

verses.en: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe o Senhor: Eu mesmo irei contigo, e eu te darei descanso.
verses.en_web: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I myself will go with you and give you rest.

verses.en: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
verses.pt: Então Moisés lhe disse: Se tu mesmo não fores conosco, não nos faças subir daqui.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said, If you yourself are not going with us, do not send us on from here.

verses.en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.pt: Como, pois, se saberá agora que tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, eu e o teu povo? acaso não é por andares tu conosco, de modo a sermos separados, eu e o teu povo, de todos os povos que há sobre a face da terra;
verses.en_web: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
verses.en_bbe: For is not the fact of your going with us the sign that I and this people have grace in your eyes, so that we, that is, I and your people, are separate from all other people on the face of the earth?

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
verses.pt: Ao que disse o Senhor a Moisés: Farei também isto que tens dito; porquanto achaste graça aos meus olhos, e te conheço pelo teu nome.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, I will do as you say: for you have grace in my eyes, and I have knowledge of you by your name.

verses.en: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
verses.pt: Moisés disse ainda: Rogo-te que me mostres a tua glória.
verses.en_web: He said, “Please show me your glory.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said, O Lord, let me see your glory.

verses.en: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe o Senhor: Eu farei passar toda a minha bondade diante de ti, e te proclamarei o meu nome Jeová; e terei misericórdia de quem eu tiver misericórdia, e me compadecerei de quem me compadecer.
verses.en_web: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I will make all the light of my being come before you, and will make clear to you what I am; I will be kind to those to whom I will be kind, and have mercy on those on whom I will have mercy.

verses.en: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
verses.pt: E disse mais: Não poderás ver a minha face, porquanto homem nenhum pode ver a minha face e viver.
verses.en_web: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
verses.en_bbe: But it is not possible for you to see my face, for no man may see me and still go on living.

verses.en: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor: Eis aqui um lugar junto a mim; aqui, sobre a penha, te poras.
verses.en_web: Yahweh also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, See, there is a place near me, and you may take your place on the rock:

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verses.pt: E quando a minha glória passar, eu te porei numa fenda da penha, e te cobrirei com a minha mão, até que eu haja passado.
verses.en_web: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;
verses.en_bbe: And when my glory goes by, I will put you in a hole in the rock, covering you with my hand till I have gone past:

verses.en: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
verses.pt: Depois, quando eu tirar a mão, me verás pelas costas; porém a minha face não se verá.
verses.en_web: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
verses.en_bbe: Then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back: but my face is not to be seen.
